{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = trial_df_deduped[trial_df_deduped['severity'] == 'SEVERE']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Confirm no missing values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients
assert severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum() == 0, "There are missing values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients"

mean_biomarker_severe"}
